'''Rogate''' is a researcher found at the '''Research Institute''' above Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Rogate:''' This is the Artificial Sun Lab, the R&D hub for Project Helios. Please refrain from touching any equipment.

:'''Rogate:''' Also, avoid prolonged direct observation of Helios. It is, technically, a contained star.

:{{DIcon}} Can you tell me more about it?

:'''Rogate: '''Certainly. "Helios,"' commonly referred to as the artificial sun, is an energy device built by the [[Spacetrek Collective]]. Its purpose is to replace the current sun above Lahai-Roi—the [[Exostrider]]'s Drive. After we return the Drive to the Exostrider, it will continue to provide sustainable energy for Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.

:'''Rogate:''' This is our first step towards the future. We`l have a sun that belongs to humanity alone... Our success would be nothing short of historic.

:'''Rogate:''' We're working to ensure this new sun illuminates Lahai-Ro's future. It's why we're here.
----
;After completing the following {{Main|Ode to the Second Sunrise}}
:'''[[Rogate]]:''' ...Oh, it's you. You're the one who helped Professor Mornye launch Helios during the New Solar Ceremony, right? Never got the chance to extend my gratitude.

:'''Rogate:''' Thank you.

:{{DIcon}} It was a collective effort.
::'''Rogate:''' Haha... I won't deny that.

:{{DIcon}} I'm just a student. I didn't help much.
::'''Rogate:''' Haha, is that so? Let's leave it at that.

:{{DIcon}} How's Helios running now?

:'''Rogate:''' Stable. Power systems, core output, and signal transmission are all in perfect sync. Not that we're letting our guard down.

:'''Rogate:''' Don't worry. We'll keep our new sun safe.
{{Dialogue End}}
